story.title: Space giants play football
paragraphs_en: It was the year 2006 on Earth. The space giants were out for a walk in the Milky Way .
They reached Earth. 'What a beautiful planet!' Krislo admired.
Suddenly, WHOOOOOOOSH!!! 'What was th...at???!!', exclaimed Nabroon. What a header from Ronaldo!!!

'Wow! What a game?!' Alo said. 'Can we play that...please?' 'Oh, Yes!' All cheered. 'But, what will we play with?' Krislo asked. Now, that was a problem! They thought long and hard. 'Idea!!' Chezrun always had one.
'Ta da...Mercury! It is just the size.' C hezrun beamed. He was very proud of his idea. 'Are you kidding me?! It is right next to the sun. We will burn.' Krislo was not impressed.
'Dont't you worry. Venus will be fine too.' Chezrun was not the one to give up on his plan. But.... 'Arrgh!! Hot, hot, hot!!' He could barely touch Venus. 'It's hotter than Mercury! Who knew?!'
'Earth?' Nabroon looked at everybody. 'Don't even think about it! It is just sooo....pretty. Let's not ruin it.' All shook their heads.
'Look!' Krislo pointed to Mars. 'Me, me, me'... Alo wanted to take the first kick. And he did. 'Aw ouch!!! This is so rocky!! I think I broke my toe!'

'Don't be sad, Alo. There's Jupiter.' Nabroon tried to cheer up Alo. 'It's huge!' Alo complained. 'Not for me'. Nabroon gave Jupiter a kick. 'Huh?? What just happened? I can't even feel it. This is all gas, man!'
'Wait here! I will be right back with just what you need.' Krislo had seen Saturn and hurried to get it. 'Ow..this ring is so dusty! Ow..ow.. it is all getting into my eyes! ' He had to let it go.
'Come on.' Malcroh called. 'See this!' He showed them Uranus, which went rolling exactly like a ball. 'Oh, it's icy! We don't want to catch a cold.' The others were not as keen.

'Aah, what a nice blue ball!' Alo was very pleased when he spotted Neptune. He ran to it all excited. 'Aaaargh...!' He flew away. Luckily Nabroon caught him right on time. 'It looked so nice! But so windy.....?!' Alo could not understand.

'Aww... I give up.' Alo was very sad by now. ﻿ Mlachro went to give him a hug, but tripped on something. 'What was that?!' 'Oh, it's Pluto. Humans just discovered it.' Chezrun knew everything. Mlachro had an idea. 'Alo, watch this.' He did a fancy bicycle kick like the man they saw on Earth. It was perfect!

Mlacroh passed Pluto to Alo. Alo dribbled it past Krislo. 'Ha, ha, ha..' Krislo did a slide tackle. And the ball (Well, Pluto!) went to Chezrun. 'Here I come!' Nabroon chased after Chezrun. Thus started space giants' game of football.

Now the scientists on Earth had a problem. 'We just added Pluto to Solar System.' 'But, it wouldn't be kind to stop space giants from playing football.' 'What do we do now?' 'Oh well, let's take Pluto off the list'. That's how we went back to an 8-planet solar system.

'Wow! What a game?!' Alo said.
'Can we play that...please?' 'Oh, Yes!' All cheered.
'But, what will we play with?' Krislo asked.
Now, that was a problem!
They thought long and hard.
'Idea!!' Chezrun always had one.
'Ta da...Mercury! It is just the size.' C hezrun beamed.
He was very proud of his idea.
'Are you kidding me?!
It is right next to the sun.
We will burn.' Krislo was not impressed.
'Dont't you worry.
Venus will be fine too.' Chezrun was not the one to give up on his plan.
But.... 'Arrgh!! Hot, hot, hot!!' He could barely touch Venus.
'It's hotter than Mercury! Who knew?!'
'Earth?' Nabroon looked at everybody.
'Don't even think about it!
It is just sooo....pretty.
Let's not ruin it.' All shook their heads.
'Look!' Krislo pointed to Mars.
'Me, me, me'...
Alo wanted to take the first kick.
And he did.
'Aw ouch!!! This is so rocky!!
I think I broke my toe!'
'Don't be sad, Alo.
There's Jupiter.' Nabroon tried to cheer up Alo.
'It's huge!' Alo complained.
'Not for me'.
Nabroon gave Jupiter a kick.
'Huh?? What just happened?
I can't even feel it.
This is all gas, man!'

'Ow..this ring is so dusty!

' He had to let it go.
'Come on.' Malcroh called.
'See this!' He showed them Uranus, which went rolling exactly like a ball.
'Oh, it's icy!
We don't want to catch a cold.' The others were not as keen.
'Aah, what a nice blue ball!' Alo was very pleased when he spotted Neptune.
He ran to it all excited.
'Aaaargh...!' He flew away.
Luckily Nabroon caught him right on time.
'It looked so nice!
But so windy.....?!' Alo could not understand.
'Aww... I give up.' Alo was very sad by now.

'What was that?!' 'Oh, it's Pluto.
Humans just discovered it.' Chezrun knew everything.
Mlachro had an idea.
'Alo, watch this.' He did a fancy bicycle kick like the man they saw on Earth.
It was perfect!
Mlacroh passed Pluto to Alo.
Alo dribbled it past Krislo.
'Ha, ha, ha..' Krislo did a slide tackle.
And the ball (Well, Pluto!) went to Chezrun.
'Here I come!' Nabroon chased after Chezrun.

'We just added Pluto to Solar System.' 'But, it wouldn't be kind to stop space giants from playing football.' 'What do we do now?' 'Oh well, let's take Pluto off the list'.
